title: just shipped 18 PRs
summary: added an ai video generator, a carl jung bot, and a browser extension for images. on the infra side, we stopped counting 4xx errors as successful requests in the model monitor, because reality matters. docs are updated too. 🐝

highlights.title: GPT Image 1.5 Large
highlights.text: We unblocked the Azure endpoints and wired up the new 1.5 large model. Better pixels, fewer timeouts. Hit the [Unified API](https://gen.pollinations.ai) to try it.

highlights.title: Unified Multimodal Chat
highlights.text: The community shipped `pollinations-ui`, a single interface that handles text, images, video, and audio without making you switch tabs. [Try it](https://pollinations-ui.vercel.app)

highlights.title: Browser Extension
highlights.text: Generate images anywhere on the web using your own Pollen credits. No need to leave the tab you're supposed to be working in. [View repo](https://github.com/ChunkyPanda29/Pollinations_Browser_Extension/)

highlights.title: SillyTavern Avatars
highlights.text: A new community extension hooks into our image API to instantly generate and assign portraits to your roleplay characters based on their text descriptions. [Try it](https://docs.sillytavern.app/)

highlights.title: Skills-Sentinel-scan
highlights.text: Added a Dockerized security scanner to the dev tools ecosystem. Because you should probably check if your AI agent is leaking credentials before letting it loose. [View repo](https://github.com/Amine-SGM/Skills-Sentinel-scan)
